source_cn:
活动规则:
源自曾经美神奥尔尼娅的封印物重现世间，可使任何目标进入“陶醉”状态。活动期间在副本人机模式下进行风尚决斗，可获得封印物中蕴含的美神之力，对敌方施加强力惩戒。
需注意：人机模式下奖励比组队模式更低
ref_en:
Event Rules: 
 A Sealed Artifact originating from the former Goddess of Beauty, Olnia, has reappeared in the world, capable of putting any target into a state of "Intoxication." During the event, conduct Fashion Duels in the dungeon's AI mode to obtain the power of the Goddess of Beauty contained within the Sealed Artifact and inflict powerful Punishment on the enemy. 
 Note: Rewards in AI mode are lower than in team mode.

source_cn: 沉默目标，减少目标体力，减少解控冷却
ref_en: Silence the target, reduce the target's stamina, and reduce the Cooldown of Cleanse.

source_cn: 【风闻】灰雾加持变为灰雾压制，有目标时，使用后依然获得可灰雾加持的效果，同时对目标100%基础概率附加沉默，持续1秒。
ref_en: [Rumor] gray fog Blessing becomes gray fog Suppression. When there is a target, using it still grants the gray fog Blessing effect, while also having a 100% base probability to Silence the target for 1 second.

source_cn: 【浅见】诗意光环内的友方和自身每次攻击目标可以回复少量生命，1秒最多触发1次，诗意光环半径增加2米。
ref_en: [Shallow Insight] Allies and yourself within the Poetic Aura recover a small amount of Health each time you attack a target. This can be triggered at most 1 time every 1 second, and the Poetic Aura radius is increased by 2 meters.

source_cn: 【实证】灰雾压制的沉默时间增加0.5秒。
ref_en: [Empirical Evidence] The Silence duration of gray fog Suppression increases by 0.5 seconds.

source_cn: 【隐迹】沉默效果正常结束造成少量伤害，被解除或者驱散时造成更高伤害。
ref_en: [Hidden Trace] The Silence effect deals a small amount of damage when it ends normally, and deals higher damage when it is removed or Dispeled.

source_cn: 【隐迹】死亡之爪生成的仪式魔法减速效果叠加3层后，有40%基础概率令目标恐惧1秒。
ref_en: [Hidden Trace] After the Slow effect of the Ritual Magic generated by the Death Claw stacks to 3 layers, it has a 40% base probability to cause Horror to the target for 1 second.

source_cn: 【本相】释放灰雾压制后，降低自身解控技能冷却时间2秒，若自身解控技能不处于冷却中，则增加灰雾加持效果持续时间1秒。
ref_en: [True Form] After releasing gray fog Suppression, reduce the Cooldown of your own Cleanse skill by 2 seconds. If your own Cleanse skill is not on Cooldown, increase the duration of the gray fog Blessing effect by 1 second.

source_cn: 【本相】仪式魔法在第3次伤害时，对于有死亡侵蚀效果的目标伤害额外提升150%，对于无死亡侵蚀的目标有20%概率附加死亡侵蚀效果。
ref_en: [True Form] Ritual Magic deals an additional 150% damage to targets with the Death Erosion effect on the 3rd hit. Targets without Death Erosion have a 20% chance to be afflicted with Death Erosion.

source_cn:
【本相】死亡烙印、死亡之握每命中一个目标都会汲取目标的一个灵魂碎片，汲取6个灵魂碎片后自身获得8秒途径压制提升10%效果。
如果技能死亡烙印、死亡之握伤害击杀目标则额外至多汲取1个碎片。
ref_en:
[True Form] Brand of Death and Grasp of Death each drain one Soul Fragment from the target upon hit. After draining 6 Soul Fragments, you gain a 10% Pathway Suppression boost for 8 seconds. 
 If the skill Brand of Death or Grasp of Death kills the target, you drain up to 1 additional fragment.

<Assistant_Title1>【推荐方案】</>
<Assistant_Title2>系统说明：</>在各个养成系统中，点击<Assistant_System>推荐方案</>按钮即可前往推荐方案系统，使用推荐方案系统可以将系统和大神玩家推荐的方案，根据自身当前养成状况，一键运用到自身方案中。
<Assistant_Title2>使用指南：</>进入推荐方案系统后，可以点击一键使用，也可以点击各个养成模块右上角的复制按钮，将全套或单独的套路运用到自身当前的方案上。在方案界面点击左下角的<Assistant_System>分享</>按钮，即可将自身当前装配的方案分享给其他非凡者。其他非凡者可通过分享码或分享链接<Assistant_System>导入</>分享的方案。
<Assistant_Title2>覆盖说明：</>覆盖后的方案为根据推荐的方案和角色当前的养成计算后的<Assistant_Red>智能搭配</>，并自动为角色装配合适的非凡物质。只有<Assistant_Red>同途径</>的非凡者直接可以进行方案的分享、导入和覆盖。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[非凡评分]|502}，{SendAnswer:[非凡方案]|508}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Recommended Builds】</>
<Assistant_Title2>System Explanation: </>In various progression systems, click the <Assistant_System>Recommended Builds</> button to access the system. You can use this to apply builds recommended by the system or top players to your own character based on your current progression status with one click.
<Assistant_Title2>Usage Guide: </>After entering the Recommended Builds system, you can click "Use All" or click the copy button in the top-right corner of each module to apply full sets or individual components to your current build. Click the <Assistant_System>Share</> button in the bottom-left corner of the build interface to share your current setup with other Beyonders. Other Beyonders can <Assistant_System>Import</> shared builds using a share code or link.
<Assistant_Title2>Overwrite Notes: </>Overwritten builds are <Assistant_Red>Intelligently Optimized</> based on the recommended build and your character's current progression, and will automatically equip suitable Beyonder materials. Only Beyonders of the <Assistant_Red>Same Pathway</> can share, import, and overwrite builds directly.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Beyonder Rating]|502}, {SendAnswer:[Beyonder Build]|508}

<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 收集异象之物</>
探索过程中，可留意散发光芒的晶状物，靠近并触碰即可完成收集。
也可通过以下方式寻找异象之物：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【异象之物】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【异象之物】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 兑换奖励</>

<Assistant_Title2>Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Collecting Objects of Phenomenon</>
During exploration, keep an eye out for glowing crystalline objects; approach and touch them to collect.
You can also find them via:
<Assistant_Property2>TRPG Entry:</>Open the menu and enter [TRPG]. After joining any sect, select [Object of Phenomenon] in the [Order World] and click [Go] to auto-path.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Object of Phenomenon] icon under [World Details], and follow the icon's guidance to find the corresponding marker on the map, then click [Go] to auto-path.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Redeeming Rewards</>
After collecting enough Objects of Phenomenon, go to the <Assistant_Red>Club</> scene and speak to <Assistant_Red>Leonard</> to redeem your rewards.

<Assistant_Title1>【终末猎杀】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>终末猎杀</>是发生在<Assistant_Property1>猎龙之城</>的野外<Assistant_Red>500人混战</>玩法。你可以击败超凡生物或敌对玩家，获得<Assistant_Property1>猩红遗物材料</>与段位胜点。
<Assistant_Title2>核心目标：</>将<Assistant_Property1>猩红遗物材料</>提交给<Assistant_System>猎杀管家</>，推进猎杀进度并解锁阶段奖励。猩红遗物仅在猎龙之城内有效，离开后将自动失效并清除。
<Assistant_Title2>猎杀时刻：</>玩法全天开放；周一至周五<Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</>为猎杀时刻；周六、周日开放<Assistant_Red>12:00—18:00、19:00—22:00</>两场猎杀时刻。猎杀时刻期间，击杀或被击杀时涉及的段位胜点数量翻倍。
<Assistant_Title2>王城事件：</>每周五、周日晚的猎杀时刻开启10分钟后，即<Assistant_Red>19:10</>，王城中心刷新巨龙·投影；除周五、周日晚场外，其他猎杀时刻开始10分钟后刷新王城守卫者。
<Assistant_Title2>巨龙参与奖励：</>玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在团队对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的<Assistant_Red>最高档位</>结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Assistant_Red>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。
<Assistant_Title2>团队结算：</>击杀者及最多29名符合助攻条件的同团队成员参与奖励结算。猩红遗物按参与人数平均分配，余数优先分配给击杀者1个，其余在其他参与者中随机分配。
<Assistant_Title2>掠夺规则：</>玩家头顶显示的碎片数量越多，抢夺猩红遗物的比例越高；头顶碎片数每提高500个，抢夺比例相应提升。
<Assistant_Title2>段位规则：</>段位低于<Assistant_Red>伯爵1阶</>时，被击杀不会损失段位胜点。每日01:00—08:00及短时间内重复击杀同一目标时，击杀玩家获得的段位胜点将按规则衰减。
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>{JumpToUI:[前往终末猎杀]|1250342}

<Assistant_Title1>【Final Hunt】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Mode Explanation: </><Assistant_System>Final Hunt</> is a <Assistant_Property1>City of Dragon Hunting</> open-world <Assistant_Red>500-player melee</> mode. You can defeat supernatural creatures or hostile players to obtain <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> and Rank Points.
<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective: </>Submit <Assistant_Property1>Scarlet Relic Materials</> to the <Assistant_System>Hunting Butler</> to advance hunting progress and unlock stage rewards. Scarlet Relics are only valid within the City of Dragon Hunting and will be automatically invalidated and cleared upon leaving.
<Assistant_Title2>Hunting Time: </>The mode is open all day; Monday to Friday <Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</> is "Hunting Time"; Saturday and Sunday feature two sessions: <Assistant_Red>12:00—18:00 and 19:00—22:00</>. During Hunting Time, Rank Points gained or lost from kills/deaths are doubled.
<Assistant_Title2>Royal City Event: </>10 minutes after the start of the Friday and Sunday evening Hunting Time, i.e., <Assistant_Red>19:10</>, a Dragon - Projection spawns in the center of the Royal City; outside of Friday and Sunday evening, the Royal City Guardian spawns 10 minutes after the start of other Hunting Time sessions.
<Assistant_Title2>Dragon Participation Rewards: </>When the Dragon in your current channel is defeated, participation rewards are calculated. Rewards are based on the percentage of the Dragon's total HP dealt by your team, settled at the <Assistant_Red>Highest Tier</> achieved, and sent via mail after the battle ends.

Each player can receive <Assistant_Red>1 participation reward</> per Dragon battle event. Once settled, switching channels to participate again will not grant additional rewards.
<Assistant_Title2>Team Settlement: </>The killer and up to 29 team members who meet assist criteria participate in reward settlement. Scarlet Relics are distributed equally among participants, with remainders prioritized for the killer, and the rest distributed randomly among other participants.
<Assistant_Title2>Plunder Rules: </>The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the percentage of Scarlet Relics that can be plundered; for every 500 fragments, the plunder ratio increases accordingly.
<Assistant_Title2>Rank Rules: </>When your rank is below <Assistant_Red>Count Tier 1</>, you will not lose Rank Points upon death. Rank Points gained from killing the same target repeatedly within a short time or between 01:00—08:00 daily will be reduced according to the rules.
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate: </>{JumpToUI:[Go to Final Hunt]|1250342}

<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>铁路大亨</>是开启城堡即可解锁的独立玩法。你需要消耗<Assistant_Property1>经销许可证</>开启不同线路，携带城堡工坊产物作为初始资本，在不同站点之间<Assistant_Property1>低买高卖</>，赚取<Assistant_Property2>商会票券</>并在结算时兑换为城堡货币。
<Assistant_Title2>核心流程：</>选择难度与携带物产 → 签订经销协议 → 逐站买卖货物 → 选择策略卡 → 完成协议目标 → 终点结算评级与奖励。

<Assistant_Title1>【Railroad Tycoon】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </><Assistant_System>Railroad Tycoon</> is an independent game mode unlocked upon opening the Castle. You need to consume <Assistant_Property1>Distribution Licenses</> to open different routes, carry Castle Workshop products as initial capital, <Assistant_Property1>buy low and sell high</> between different stations, earn <Assistant_Property2>Chamber of Commerce Tickets</>, and exchange them for Castle currency during settlement. 
<Assistant_Title2>Core Process: </>Select difficulty and carry products → Sign distribution agreements → Buy and sell goods station by station → Select strategy cards → Complete agreement goals → Final settlement rating and rewards.

<Assistant_Title1>【歌剧魅影-比赛与奖励】</>
<Assistant_Title2>比赛流程：</>双方俱乐部各派5名选手，按顺序依次进行5场走秀对抗。每局会播放双方选手的表演动画，非凡者可以赠送礼物和点赞来影响双方的分数，最终根据表演总分和额外分数之和判断胜负。
<Assistant_Title2>胜负规则：</>如果双方分数打平时，会在比较选手的风尚度，若风尚度也相同，最后比俱乐部赛区排名。整场比赛以5局的总胜场数决定胜负，胜场相同时排名高的俱乐部获胜。
<Assistant_Title2>奖励规则：</>入场观战的非凡者可随时间获得观战奖励；入场观战/作为参赛选手，即可在比赛完成时歌剧魅影的奖励，每赛季结束时，俱乐部参赛前五名还会获得称号奖励
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Phantom of the Opera-Competition and Rewards】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Competition Process: </>Each club sends 5 contestants to perform 5 runway duels in order. Each match will play the performance animation of both contestants. Beyonders can give gifts and likes to influence the scores of both sides. The winner is determined based on the sum of the total performance score and extra scores. 
<Assistant_Title2>Win/Loss Rules: </>If both sides are tied in score, the contestants' Fashion Rating will be compared. If the Fashion Rating is also the same, the club's regional ranking will be compared last. The entire competition is decided by the total number of wins in the 5 rounds. If the number of wins is the same, the club with the higher ranking wins. 
<Assistant_Title2>Reward Rules: </>Beyonders who enter to watch the match can receive viewing rewards over time; by entering to watch/participating as a contestant, you can receive Phantom of the Opera rewards when the competition ends. At the end of each season, the top five participating members of the club will also receive title rewards.

<Assistant_Title1>【俱乐部】</>
<Assistant_Title2>开放等级：</>认知等级<Assistant_Red>20级</>
<Assistant_Title2>系统入口：</><Assistant_System>菜单-俱乐部</>{JumpToUI:[【前往查看】]|1250052}
<Assistant_Title2>系统介绍：</>角色等级到达20级，可以选择加入俱乐部或自行创建俱乐部。参与各种俱乐部活动玩法，获取丰厚的活动奖励和同行纹章，同行纹章可在俱乐部商店中兑换奖励道具。
<Assistant_Title2>创建俱乐部：</>创建俱乐部需要缴纳创建费用，创建后24小时内响应人数达到4人则创建成功，超时将创建失败。<Assistant_Red>创建失败和主动取消创建，都不会返还创建费用。</>
<Assistant_Title2>俱乐部类型：</>俱乐部分为休闲俱乐部和战斗俱乐部，可在俱乐部信息修改处进行调整，休闲俱乐部不会在成员列表显示非凡评分。
<Assistant_Title2>俱乐部徽章：</>俱乐部徽章随获取途径的发奖同步结算：竞赛徽章在玩法结算后发放，玩法徽章在下周一0点发放。
<Assistant_Title2>改名道具：</>可在<Assistant_System>商城 - 秘藏陈列</>中购买更名布告，更改俱乐部的名称和徽章字。
<Assistant_Title2>活动限制：</>1.俱乐部成员锁定规则：在以俱乐部为单位的玩法活动（如<Assistant_System>四方联赛、歌剧魅影、猎城战、高原战、战略服相关玩法</>）期间，俱乐部<Assistant_Red>不允许成员的加入和退出。</>
2.俱乐部活动途径人数限制：部分俱乐部活动对参与成员的<Assistant_Red>途径人数</>有限制要求，详情可见俱乐部活动说明。
3.参与活动前请先确认职位分配情况，<Assistant_Red>部分活动仅支持正式会员参赛</>，正式会员是俱乐部的中坚力量，可以参与俱乐部内的玩法活动；候补成员是俱乐部的储备力量，部分俱乐部活动无法参与，可以保持活跃状态，联系管理转正为会员。
4.战略服期间成员限制：获得战略服资格的俱乐部，在战略服持续期间，<Assistant_Red>每周最多可加入10名新成员。</>名额每周一上午8:00刷新，未使用名额不累积、不延续至下一周。<Assistant_Red>战略服玩法活动期间（19:00~22:00）会触发成员锁定规则，暂时禁止成员变更。</>
<Assistant_Title3>基础功能细节规则：</>{SendAnswer:[俱乐部-俱乐部建筑和资金]|1401}，{SendAnswer:[俱乐部-俱乐部职位]|1402}，{SendAnswer:[俱乐部-俱乐部活跃]|1403}，{SendAnswer:[场景-俱乐部]|567}

<Assistant_Title1>【Club】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Unlock Level: </>Cognition Level<Assistant_Red> 20</>
<Assistant_Title2>System Entry: </><Assistant_System>Menu-Club</>{JumpToUI:[【Go to View】]|1250052}
<Assistant_Title2>System Introduction: </>Once your character reaches level 20, you can choose to join a club or create your own. Participate in various club activities to earn generous rewards and Companion Emblems, which can be exchanged for reward items in the Club Shop. 
<Assistant_Title2>Creating a Club: </>Creating a club requires paying a creation fee. If 4 people respond within 24 hours after creation, the creation is successful; otherwise, it will fail. <Assistant_Red>Neither failed creation nor voluntary cancellation will result in a refund of the creation fee. </>
<Assistant_Title2>Club Types: </>Clubs are divided into Leisure Clubs and Combat Clubs, which can be adjusted in the club information modification section. Leisure Clubs will not display Beyonder ratings in the member list. 
<Assistant_Title2>Club Emblems: </>Club emblems are settled synchronously with the distribution of rewards from the acquisition source: Competition Emblems are distributed after the game mode settlement, and game mode emblems are distributed at 0:00 on the following Monday. 
<Assistant_Title2>Rename Items: </>You can purchase a Renaming Notice in <Assistant_System>Mall-Treasured Collection</> to change the club's name and emblem characters. 
<Assistant_Title2>Activity Restrictions: </>1. Club Member Lock Rule: During club-based game activities (such as <Assistant_System>Four-Way League, Phantom of the Opera, Hunting City Battle, Highland Battle, Strategic Server related modes</>), clubs <Assistant_Red>do not allow members to join or leave.</> 
2. Club Activity Pathway Number Restrictions: Some club activities have restrictions on the <Assistant_Red>number of Pathways</> of participating members. For details, see the club activity description. 
3. Please confirm the position allocation before participating in activities. <Assistant_Red>Some activities only support official members to participate</>. Official members are the backbone of the club and can participate in club activities; reserve members are the reserve force of the club and cannot participate in some club activities. You can maintain an active status and contact management to be promoted to a member. 
4. Member Restrictions During Strategic Server: Clubs qualified for the Strategic Server can <Assistant_Red>add up to 10 new members per week</> during the Strategic Server period. The quota refreshes at 8:00 AM every Monday, and unused quotas do not accumulate or carry over to the next week. <Assistant_Red>During Strategic Server game activities (19:00~22:00), the member lock rule will be triggered, temporarily prohibiting member changes. </>
<Assistant_Title3>Basic Function Detail Rules: </>{SendAnswer:[Club-Club Buildings and Funds]|1401}, {SendAnswer:[Club-Club Positions]|1402}, {SendAnswer:[Club-Club Activity]|1403}, {SendAnswer:[Scene-Club]|567}

<Assistant_Title1>【俱乐部-俱乐部职位】</>
<Assistant_Title2>会长：</>会长是俱乐部的领袖，拥有最高权限，可代表俱乐部行使各项内部管理和外交权利的处理。
<Assistant_Title2>外交官：</>外交官是辅助会长的重要职位，拥有仅次于会长的高等权限，可代替会长行使部分内部管理权限和外交权利，由会长任命。
<Assistant_Title2>理事：</>理事是俱乐部中的管理职位，拥有一定程度的管理权限，由会长任命，最多3位。

<Assistant_Title1>【Club-Club Positions】</>
<Assistant_Title2>President: </>The President is the leader of the club and has the highest authority, representing the club in exercising various internal management and diplomatic rights. 
<Assistant_Title2>Diplomat: </>The Diplomat is an important position assisting the President, possessing high authority second only to the President. They can act on behalf of the President in exercising some internal management and diplomatic rights, and are appointed by the President. 
<Assistant_Title2>Councilor: </>Councilors are management positions in the club, possessing a certain degree of management authority, appointed by the President, with a maximum of 3. 
<Assistant_Title2>Group Leader: </>Group Leaders are the core management of club activities, responsible for the appointment and removal of members within the group, organizing league group activities, and other game activities. There are 4 groups under each club, each with a maximum of 30 people. Members within the group automatically gain qualification to participate in the league. 
<Assistant_Title2>Club Star: </>Club Stars are the face of the club, responsible for recruiting and entertaining new members, appointed by the President, with a maximum of 2. 
<Assistant_Title2>Official Member: </>Official members are the backbone of the club and can participate in guild activities. <Assistant_Red>Some activities only support official members to participate</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Reserve Member: </>Reserve members are the reserve force of the club and cannot participate in some guild activities. You can continue to work hard, maintain activity, and contact management to join as a member. 
<Assistant_Title2>Position Adjustment: </>Club members can hold management positions, group positions, and Club Star positions concurrently; management positions include President, Diplomat, and Councilor. 
<Assistant_Title2>Permission Adjustment: </>The Club President can adjust the permission allocation for different positions in the permission adjustment interface. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Club]|1400}, {SendAnswer:[Club-Club Buildings and Funds]|1401}, {SendAnswer:[Club-Club Activity]|1403}

<Assistant_Title1>【乘区】</>
指伤害或治疗结算公式里<Assistant_Red>独立相乘</>的几大类加成，最终数值 = 各乘区数值相乘。
对伤害结算，存在“基础值区”、“格挡区”、“暴击区”、“增伤区”、“伤害加深区”、“场景区”等。
对治疗结算，存在“基础值区”、“治疗增幅区”、“受治疗增幅区”、“途径区”、“场景区”等
因为乘法放大收益，所以相同比例的提升，加在数值较小的乘区，收益比加在数值较大的乘区更大。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[伤害计算]|1499}，{SendAnswer:[治疗计算]|1500}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Multiplier】</>
Refers to the major categories of bonuses that are <Assistant_Red>multiplied independently</> in damage or healing calculation formulas. Final value = the product of all multipliers. 
For damage calculation, there are categories such as "Base Value Zone," "Block Zone," "Crit Zone," "Damage Boost Zone," "Damage Deepening Zone," and "Scenario Zone." 
For healing calculation, there are categories such as "Base Value Zone," "Healing Boost Zone," "Received Healing Boost Zone," "Pathway Zone," and "Scenario Zone." 
Because multiplication amplifies gains, a boost of the same percentage yields a greater benefit when added to a smaller multiplier than when added to a larger one. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search: </>{SendAnswer:[Damage Calculation]|1499}, {SendAnswer:[Healing Calculation]|1500}

<Assistant_Title1>【伤害计算】</>
伤害= 伤害基础值×格挡判断区×暴击判断区×途径区×场景区×增减伤1区×增减伤2区…
<Assistant_Title2>伤害基础值：</>伤害基础值=<Assistant_Property1>攻击基础值</>+<Assistant_Property2>技能基础值</>。
<Assistant_Title2>攻击基础值：</>取决于进攻方<Assistant_Red>攻击</>和<Assistant_Red>技能倍率</>，受到双方<Assistant_Red>破甲/护甲</>、<Assistant_Red>防御/破防</>、<Assistant_Red>专攻/专防</>等属性对抗的修正。
<Assistant_Title2>技能基础值：</>取决于进攻方<Assistant_Red>技能等级</>和<Assistant_Red>技能系数</>，受到双方<Assistant_Red>技能增强/技能抵挡</>属性对抗的修正。（注：普通攻击也是技能，也有技能基础值）
<Assistant_Title2>格挡判断区：</>基础格挡率为<Assistant_Red>25%</>，概率受到双方<Assistant_Red>穿刺/格挡</>属性对抗的修正。格挡时，受到30%伤害且不会触发暴击。
<Assistant_Title2>暴击判断区：</>基础暴击率为<Assistant_Red>25%</>，概率受到双方<Assistant_Red>暴击/抗暴击</>属性对抗的修正。暴击时，伤害将根据双方<Assistant_Red>暴伤/暴伤减免</>的属性对抗，提高一定倍率。

<Assistant_Title1>【Damage Calculation】</>
Damage = Base Damage × Block Judgment Zone × Critical Judgment Zone × Pathway Zone × Scenario Zone × Damage Boost/Reduction Zone 1 × Damage Boost/Reduction Zone 2...
<Assistant_Title2>Base Damage: </>Base Damage = <Assistant_Property1>Base Attack</> + <Assistant_Property2>Base Skill Value</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Base Attack: </>Depends on the attacker's <Assistant_Red>Attack</> and <Assistant_Red>Skill Multiplier</>, modified by the confrontation of both sides' <Assistant_Red>Armor Break/Armor</>, <Assistant_Red>Defense/Armor Break</>, <Assistant_Red>Specialization/Special Defense</>, and other attributes.
<Assistant_Title2>Base Skill Value: </>Depends on the attacker's <Assistant_Red>Skill Level</> and <Assistant_Red>Skill Coefficient</>, modified by the confrontation of both sides' <Assistant_Red>Skill Enhancement/Skill Block</> attributes. (Note: Normal Attack is also a skill and has a Base Skill Value)
<Assistant_Title2>Block Judgment Zone: </>Base Block Rate is <Assistant_Red>25%</>, the probability is modified by the confrontation of both sides' <Assistant_Red>Piercing/Block</> attributes. When blocking, 30% damage is taken and critical hits will not be triggered.
<Assistant_Title2>Critical Judgment Zone: </>Base Critical Rate is <Assistant_Red>25%</>, the probability is modified by the confrontation of both sides' <Assistant_Red>Critical/Anti-Critical</> attributes. When a critical hit occurs, damage is increased by a certain multiplier based on the confrontation of both sides' <Assistant_Red>Crit Damage/Crit Damage Reduction</> attributes.
<Assistant_Title2>Pathway Zone: </>Inherent damage boost or reduction of certain Pathways.
<Assistant_Title2>Scenario Zone: </>Inherent damage boost or reduction of certain scenarios.
<Assistant_Title2>Damage Boost/Reduction Zone: </>Both sides' <Assistant_Red>Damage Boost/Damage Reduction</> and <Assistant_Red>Damage Increased/Damage Reduction</> are located in different multiplier zones. Most damage boost/reduction provided by skills are in the <Assistant_Red>Damage Boost/Damage Reduction</> zone, while a small number of skills have independent multiplier zones. Most damage boost/reduction provided by progression are in the <Assistant_Red>Damage Increased/Damage Reduction zone</>, while a small number of progression systems have independent multiplier zones.
<Assistant_Title2>Final Damage: </>After all multiplier zones are calculated, <Assistant_Red>Final Damage Enhancement/Final Damage Block</> will modify the final damage value.
<Assistant_Title2>Guaranteed Damage: </>When the defender's damage reduction ability is too strong, the damage will not be lower than a certain percentage of the base value; in this case, Guaranteed Damage is dealt.
<Assistant_Title2>Tips: </>The multiplier zones for some special damage types will change, such as fixed damage.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Search: </>{SendAnswer:[Multiplier Zone]|1496}, {SendAnswer:[Fixed Damage]|1487}, {SendAnswer:[Threshold]|1638}

<Assistant_Title1>【Armor Break】</>
The attacker's attack will be numerically modified based on the confrontation between both sides' Armor Break and Armor.
When your Armor Break is less than ¼ of the target's Armor, every 1 point of Armor Break increases your Attack by 2.
When your Armor Break is more than ¼ of the target's Armor but less than the target's Armor, every 3 points of Armor Break increase your Attack by 2.
When your Armor Break exceeds the target's Armor, every 3 points of Armor Break increase your Attack by 1.
<Assistant_Title2>Tips: </>When only considering the Armor Break-Armor confrontation, the benefit of increasing 1 point of Armor Break is always positive.

<Assistant_Title1>【Skill Enhancement】</>
Increases the Base Skill Value of damage skills, offset by the target's Skill Block. (Note: Normal Attack is also a skill and has a Base Skill Value)
The Base Skill Value is not affected by <Assistant_Property1>Attack</> or <Assistant_Property2>Defense</>, depends on the <Assistant_Red>Skill Coefficient</> and <Assistant_Red>Skill Level</>, and is modified by Skill Enhancement.
The modified Base Skill Value has an upper limit of <Assistant_Red>250%</> and a lower limit of <Assistant_Red>5%</>; when the increased Skill Enhancement exceeds the upper threshold or fails to reach the lower threshold, it cannot increase damage-dealing ability.
The actual effect and threshold depend on the confrontation settlement between both sides' <Assistant_Red>Level</> and the opponent's <Assistant_Red>Skill Block</> attribute.

<Assistant_Title1>【防御】</>
减免受到伤害的攻击基础值，无法减免伤害的技能基础值。
减免后的攻击基础值存在<Assistant_Red>75%</>的上限和<Assistant_Red>20%</>的下限，提升的防御超出上阈值或未到下阈值时，无法提升减伤能力。
实际效果和阈值取决于攻防双方<Assistant_Red>等级</>，与对方<Assistant_Red>破防</>、<Assistant_Red>忽视防御</>属性的对抗结算。
<Assistant_Title2>温馨提示：</>本属性区分物理和魔法。

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Defense】</>
Reduces the base attack value of incoming damage, but does not reduce the base skill value of damage.
The reduced base attack value has an upper limit of <Assistant_Red>75%</> and a lower limit of <Assistant_Red>20%</>. If the increased defense exceeds the upper threshold or fails to reach the lower threshold, it cannot further improve damage reduction capabilities.
The actual effect and thresholds depend on the <Assistant_Red>Level</> of both the attacker and defender, and are calculated against the opponent's <Assistant_Red>Armor Break</> and <Assistant_Red>Ignore Defense</> attributes.
<Assistant_Title2>Tip: </>This attribute distinguishes between physical and magical damage.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search: </>{SendAnswer:[Damage Calculation]|1499}

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【护甲】</>
攻击方的攻击会根据双方的破甲-护甲对抗进行数值修正。
自身护甲超过伤害来源破甲的4倍时，每1点护甲降低伤害来源1点攻击。
自身护甲超过伤害来源破甲，但低于伤害来源破甲的4倍时，每3点护甲降低伤害来源2点攻击。
自身护甲低于伤害来源破甲时，每3点护甲降低伤害来源1点攻击。
<Assistant_Title2>温馨提示：</>仅考虑破甲-护甲对抗时，增长1点护甲的收益是恒为正的。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[攻击]|1519}
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Armor】</>
The attacker's attack is adjusted based on the Armor Break vs. Armor confrontation between both parties.
When your Armor exceeds 4 times the attacker's Armor Break, every 1 point of Armor reduces the attacker's attack by 1.
When your Armor exceeds the attacker's Armor Break but is less than 4 times it, every 3 points of Armor reduce the attacker's attack by 2.
When your Armor is lower than the attacker's Armor Break, every 3 points of Armor reduce the attacker's attack by 1.
<Assistant_Title2>Tip: </>When only considering the Armor Break vs. Armor confrontation, the benefit of increasing 1 point of Armor is always positive.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search: </>{SendAnswer:[Attack]|1519}

<Assistant_Title1>【技能抵挡】</>
减免所受伤害的技能基础值，抵消伤害来源的技能增强。（注：普通攻击也是技能，也有技能基础值）
技能基础值不受<Assistant_Property1>攻击</>和<Assistant_Property2>防御</>影响，取决于<Assistant_Red>技能系数</>和<Assistant_Red>技能等级</>。
修正后的技能基础值存在<Assistant_Red>250%</>的上限和<Assistant_Red>5%</>的下限，提升的技能抵挡超出上阈值或未到下阈值时，无法提升减伤能力。
实际效果和阈值取决于攻防双方<Assistant_Red>等级</>、与对方<Assistant_Red>技能增强</>属性的对抗结算。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[伤害计算]|1499}

<Assistant_Title1>【Skill Block】</>
Reduces the base skill value of incoming damage and offsets the attacker's Skill Enhancement. (Note: Normal Attacks are also considered skills and have a base skill value.)
The base skill value is not affected by <Assistant_Property1>Attack</> or <Assistant_Property2>Defense</>, but depends on the <Assistant_Red>Skill Coefficient</> and <Assistant_Red>Skill Level</>.
The adjusted base skill value has an upper limit of <Assistant_Red>250%</> and a lower limit of <Assistant_Red>5%</>. If the increased Skill Block exceeds the upper threshold or fails to reach the lower threshold, it cannot further improve damage reduction capabilities.
The actual effect and thresholds depend on the <Assistant_Red>Level</> of both the attacker and defender, and are calculated against the opponent's <Assistant_Red>Skill Enhancement</> attribute.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search: </>{SendAnswer:[Damage Calculation]|1499}

<Assistant_Title1>【Attribute Recommendation】</>
<Assistant_Title2>System Explanation:</>Click <Assistant_System>Menu</>-<Assistant_System>Character</>, select the <Assistant_Red>Target Scenario</> for recommended attribute cultivation on the right, and the system will automatically calculate the three most recommended attributes to cultivate.
<Assistant_Title2>Calculation Logic:</>Based on the Beyonder's selected <Assistant_Red>Target Scenario</>, the Beyonder's <Assistant_Red>Current Attributes</>, and the <Assistant_Red>Opponent's Attributes</>, <Assistant_Red>dynamically</> recommend attributes for the Beyonder to cultivate that have a higher <Assistant_Red>Expected Return</>;
<Assistant_Title2>Calculation Scope:</>Only common <Assistant_Red>Damage Attributes</> are calculated; some unlisted attributes are not included in the calculation.
<Assistant_Title2>Cultivation Difficulty:</>Different attributes have different cultivation difficulties (e.g., for the same grade of Gift, the values for increasing Attack and Skill Enhancement differ). Whether it is recommended is also influenced by the attribute's <Assistant_Red>Ability Improvement Magnitude</> and <Assistant_Red>Cultivation Difficulty</>.
<Assistant_Title2>Threshold:</>After some attributes are significantly increased (or when there is a large difference compared to the opponent's opposing attribute), if the threshold is exceeded, the return on the excess portion will <Assistant_Red>drop to zero</> and will no longer be recommended.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search:</>{SendAnswer:[Attribute Display]|1501}, {SendAnswer:[Ability Evaluation]|1635}, {SendAnswer:[Threshold]|1638}

<Assistant_Title2>计算范围：</>仅展示此物品的<Assistant_Red>属性词条</>带来的能力提升，不考虑特殊效果（如装备的烙印、套装、恩赐效果，封印物愚者词条）的影响；仅计算常见的<Assistant_Red>攻防属性</>，部分特殊属性不纳入计算范围。
<Assistant_Title2>计算逻辑：</>提升幅度会随选取的<Assistant_Red>目标场景</>、非凡者<Assistant_Red>当前属性</>和<Assistant_Red>对抗目标的属性</>变动，并非完全准确，仅供参考。
<Assistant_Title2>阈值：</>当非凡者<Assistant_Red>当前属性</>与<Assistant_Red>对抗目标的属性</>差距过大时，部分效果值已达上限或下限，提升幅度会迅速衰减甚至归零。

<Assistant_Title1>【Ability Evaluation】</>
<Assistant_Title2>System Explanation:</>Click <Assistant_System>Equipment</> or <Assistant_System>Beyonder material</>, and in the pop-up description, the system will automatically calculate the current item's <Assistant_Red>Ability Improvement Magnitude</> in the specified scenario.
<Assistant_Title2>Calculation Scope:</>Only displays the ability improvement brought by this item's <Assistant_Red>Attribute Affixes</>; special effects (such as equipment imprints, sets, Gift effects, Sealed Artifact The Fool affixes) are not considered; only common <Assistant_Red>Attack/Defense Attributes</> are calculated; some special attributes are not included in the calculation.
<Assistant_Title2>Calculation Logic:</>The improvement magnitude will change with the selected <Assistant_Red>Target Scenario</>, the Beyonder's <Assistant_Red>Current Attributes</>, and the <Assistant_Red>Opponent's Attributes</>; it is not entirely accurate and is for reference only.
<Assistant_Title2>Threshold:</>When the gap between the Beyonder's <Assistant_Red>Current Attributes</> and the <Assistant_Red>Opponent's Attributes</> is too large, some effect values will reach their upper or lower limits, and the improvement magnitude will decay rapidly or even drop to zero.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search:</>{SendAnswer:[Attribute Display]|1501}, {SendAnswer:[Attribute Recommendation]|1634}, {SendAnswer:[Threshold]|1638}

<Assistant_Title2>阈值属性：</>包括防御/破防、穿刺/格挡、暴击/抗暴击、技能增强/技能抵挡、暴伤/暴伤减免等对抗属性，提升均存在阈值，提升的属性未到下阈值或超出上阈值时，<Assistant_Red>无法</>提升攻击或防守能力。
<Assistant_Title2>非阈值属性：</>除防守属性过于极端、造成<Assistant_Red>保底伤害</>、超过属性值限制等极少数情况，攻击、破甲/护甲、增伤/减伤、伤害加深/伤害减免等对抗属性提升时通常不存在阈值，每增加1点属性，均可以提升攻击或防守能力。
<Assistant_Title2>阈值的可变性：</>实际战斗中的阈值，取决于攻防双方<Assistant_Red>等级</>，与对方<Assistant_Red>对抗属性</>的结算。以暴击率为例，当攻击方暴击为很大的固定值时，由于暴击率存在<Assistant_Red>75%</>的上限和<Assistant_Red>5%</>的下限，当防守方抗暴击逐渐提升时，实际暴击率先稳定在<Assistant_Red>75%</>，随后逐渐下降，最终稳定于<Assistant_Red>5%</>。当攻击方的暴击和等级变化时，实际暴击率从<Assistant_Red>75%</>和<Assistant_Red>5%</>开始变动所需的抗暴击值也会变化

<Assistant_Title1>【Threshold】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Threshold Attributes:</>Including Defense/Armor Break, Pierce/Block, Critical Hit/Anti-Critical Hit, Skill Enhancement/Skill Block, Crit Damage/Crit Damage Reduction, etc. These opposing attributes all have thresholds for their increases. If the increased attribute has not reached the lower threshold or exceeds the upper threshold, it <Assistant_Red>cannot</> improve attack or defensive capabilities.
<Assistant_Title2>Non-Threshold Attributes:</>Except for extreme cases where defensive attributes are too extreme, causing <Assistant_Red>minimum damage</>, or exceeding attribute value limits, opposing attributes such as Attack, Armor Break/Armor, Damage Boost/Damage Reduction, Damage Amplification/Damage Reduction, etc., usually do not have thresholds when increased. Each point of attribute added can improve attack or defensive capabilities.
<Assistant_Title2>Variability of Thresholds:</>The threshold in actual combat depends on the <Assistant_Red>Level</> of both the attacker and defender, and the settlement with the opponent's <Assistant_Red>Opposing Attributes</>. Taking Critical Hit Rate as an example, when the attacker's Critical Hit is a large fixed value, because there is a <Assistant_Red>75%</> upper limit and a <Assistant_Red>5%</> lower limit for Critical Hit Rate, as the defender's Anti-Critical Hit gradually increases, the actual Critical Hit Rate first stabilizes at <Assistant_Red>75%</>, then gradually decreases, and finally stabilizes at <Assistant_Red>5%</>. When the attacker's Critical Hit and Level change, the Anti-Critical Hit value required for the actual Critical Hit Rate to start changing from <Assistant_Red>75%</> and <Assistant_Red>5%</> will also change.
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended search:</>{SendAnswer:[Damage Calculation]|1499}, {SendAnswer:[Ability Evaluation]|1635}

<Assistant_Title1>【专属长椅】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法背景：</>在鲁恩的街头，有一把特殊的<Assistant_Property1>专属长椅</>。当你坐下时，你的好友幻影会前来为你递火，展示你的社交排面。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法规则：</>
1. 每条分线仅有一把<Assistant_Property1>专属长椅</>，同时只能有一名玩家坐下。
2. 坐下后，系统会根据你的<Assistant_Property2>风尚度</>召唤1~8位好友幻影为你递火。
3. 好友幻影将从好友列表中随机选择好友，好友度越高选中的概率越高。
4. 好友数量不足时，按实际好友数显示。
5. 长椅冷却仅针对使用者本人，不影响其他玩家使用同一把椅子；玩家使用专属长椅后，该长椅进入1分钟冷却。
6. 可在<Assistant_Property1>设置-社交-互动设置</>中自主调整是否参与递火玩法，关闭后你将不会为他人递火。
<Assistant_Title2>风尚度与人数：</>
- 风尚度100：1位好友
- 风尚度5000：2位好友
- 风尚度10000：3位好友
- 风尚度20000：4位好友
- 风尚度40000：5位好友
- 风尚度60000：6位好友
- 风尚度80000：7位好友
- 风尚度100000：8位好友（满员）

- {SendAnswer:[借个火]|1788}
- {SendAnswer:[众人拥护的排面]|1789}
- {SendAnswer:[鲁恩街头的神秘传说]|1790}
<Assistant_Title2>玩法入口：</>
寻找专属长椅并坐下。前往{Location:[廷根(879,785)]|-12148;-21313;-1390;2;5200002;0}。

<Assistant_Title1>【Exclusive Bench】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Background:</> On the streets of Loen, there is a special <Assistant_Property1>Exclusive Bench</>. When you sit down, your friend phantoms will come to light your cigarette, showing off your social status.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Rules:</>
1. Each channel has only one <Assistant_Property1>Exclusive Bench</>, and only one player can sit on it at a time.
2. After sitting down, the system will summon 1~8 friend phantoms to light your cigarette based on your <Assistant_Property2>Style Rating</>.
3. Friend phantoms will be randomly selected from your friend list; the higher the friendship level, the higher the probability of being selected.
4. If there are not enough friends, it will display based on the actual number of friends.
5. The bench Cooldown only applies to the user themselves and does not affect other players using the same bench; after a player uses the Exclusive Bench, that bench enters a 1-minute Cooldown.
6. You can independently adjust whether to participate in the cigarette-lighting gameplay in <Assistant_Property1>Settings-Social-Interaction Settings</>; after closing, you will not light cigarettes for others.
<Assistant_Title2>Style Rating and Number of People:</>
- Style Rating 100: 1 friend
- Style Rating 5000: 2 friends
- Style Rating 10000: 3 friends
- Style Rating 20000: 4 friends
- Style Rating 40000: 5 friends
- Style Rating 60000: 6 friends
- Style Rating 80000: 7 friends
- Style Rating 100000: 8 friends (Full)
<Assistant_Title2>Related Achievements:</>
- {SendAnswer:[Borrow a Light]|1788}
- {SendAnswer:[The Status of Being Supported by Everyone]|1789}
- {SendAnswer:[Mysterious Legend of the Streets of Loen]|1790}
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Entry:</>
Find an Exclusive Bench and sit down. Go to {Location:[Tingen (879,785)]|-12148;-21313;-1390;2;5200002;0}.

<Assistant_Title1>【战略服终末猎杀】</>
<Assistant_Title2>参与方式：</>获得战略服参与资格后，可从战略服终末猎杀入口前往<Assistant_Property1>猎龙之城</>。{JumpToUI:[前往战略服终末猎杀]|1302559}
<Assistant_Title2>开放时间：</>战场全天开放；周一至周五<Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</>为高倍时间；周六、周日开放<Assistant_Red>12:00—18:00、19:00—22:00</>两场高倍时间。巨龙讨伐于<Assistant_Red>每周四、周六19:00—20:00</>开放，巨龙·投影于<Assistant_Red>19:10</>现身猎龙城王城中心。
<Assistant_Title2>势力对抗：</>同势力成员互为友方，其他势力为敌方。仅在高倍活动时段内，击杀或助攻敌方势力的非凡者可获得<Assistant_Property1>战功</>。击杀或助攻还可按规则夺取猩红遗物。
<Assistant_Title2>猩红遗物：</>击败召唤的超凡生物也可获得猩红遗物。将遗物提交给<Assistant_System>猎杀管家</>，获得<Assistant_Property1>征服声望</>、推进猎杀进度并解锁阶段奖励。本服与战略服共享猎杀进度和召怪次数；遗物仅在猎龙之城内有效，离开后将清除。
<Assistant_Title2>讨伐巨龙：</>在巨龙周围<Assistant_Red>40米</>内存活并造成伤害，可为所属势力累计有效归属伤害。同势力不同团队的伤害合并计算。巨龙被击退时，当前有效归属伤害最高的势力取得最终归属，最后一击不会替代该判定。
<Assistant_Title2>伤害衰减：</>死亡、离开巨龙讨伐范围或切换分线后，个人累计归属伤害开始衰减，并同步减少势力有效伤害。前5秒保持不变，从第6秒开始，每6秒减少原累计伤害的5%，持续120秒后归零；重新进入范围并恢复参战后停止衰减，从剩余伤害继续累计。
<Assistant_Title2>势力拍卖：</><Assistant_Red>两条分线的巨龙全部被击败后</>，根据各势力取得最终归属的巨龙数量，开启对应档位的势力拍卖。同一势力取得<Assistant_Red>两条巨龙</>的最终归属，可开启更丰厚的拍卖奖励。玩家在活动期间参与，即可获得拍卖资格和分红奖励。每次活动中，每名玩家最多取得<Assistant_Red>1次</>巨龙拍卖资格。活动结束前未击退巨龙时，巨龙离开且不触发击杀结算。
<Assistant_Title2>参与奖励：</>玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在势力对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的<Assistant_Red>最高档位</>结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Assistant_Red>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。
<Assistant_Title2>神选积分：</>神选积分按巨龙最终归属结算，获胜势力内符合条件的俱乐部可获得<Assistant_Red>300点神选积分</>。每个俱乐部每次讨伐巨龙活动最多可获得<Assistant_Red>2次</>神选积分奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>分线人数：</>每个战区常驻开放<Assistant_Red>2条分线</>，每条分线中，单个势力最多<Assistant_Red>160名玩家</>，单条分线总人数最多<Assistant_Red>640人</>。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Strategic Server Final Hunt】</>
<Assistant_Title2>How to Participate: </>Once you have obtained the qualification to participate in the Strategic Server, you can head to the <Assistant_Property1>City of Dragon Hunting</> via the Strategic Server Final Hunt entrance. {JumpToUI:[Go to Strategic Server Final Hunt]|1302559}
<Assistant_Title2>Opening Hours: </>The battlefield is open all day; Monday to Friday <Assistant_Red>19:00—20:00</> are high-multiplier periods; Saturday and Sunday feature two high-multiplier periods: <Assistant_Red>12:00—18:00 and 19:00—22:00</>. The Dragon Crusade is open <Assistant_Red>every Thursday and Saturday from 19:00—20:00</>, and the Dragon - Projection will appear <Assistant_Red>at 19:10</> in the center of the Royal City of the City of Dragon Hunting. 
<Assistant_Title2>Faction Conflict: </>Members of the same faction are allies, while other factions are enemies. Only during high-multiplier event periods can you earn <Assistant_Property1>Battle Merits</> by killing or assisting in the kills of Beyonders from enemy factions. You can also seize Scarlet Relics according to the rules by killing or assisting. 
<Assistant_Title2>Scarlet Relics: </>Defeating summoned extraordinary creatures can also yield Scarlet Relics. Submit the relics to the <Assistant_System>Hunt Butler</> to earn <Assistant_Property1>Conquest Prestige</>, advance the hunting progress, and unlock stage rewards. The current server and the Strategic Server share hunting progress and monster summon counts; relics are only effective within the City of Dragon Hunting and will be cleared upon leaving. 
<Assistant_Title2>Crusade Against the Dragon: </>Surviving and dealing damage within <Assistant_Red>40 meters</> of the Dragon will accumulate effective attribution damage for your faction. Damage from different teams within the same faction is calculated collectively. When the Dragon is repelled, the faction with the highest current effective attribution damage gains final ownership; the final blow does not override this judgment. 
<Assistant_Title2>Damage Decay: </>After death, leaving the Dragon Crusade range, or switching channels, your accumulated personal attribution damage will begin to decay, and the faction's effective damage will be reduced accordingly. The damage remains unchanged for the first 5 seconds. Starting from the 6th second, it decreases by 5% of the original accumulated damage every 6 seconds, reaching zero after 120 seconds of continuous decay; re-entering the range and resuming combat stops the decay, and accumulation continues from the remaining damage. 
<Assistant_Title2>Faction Auction: </><Assistant_Red>After all Dragons in both channels are defeated</>, faction auctions of corresponding tiers will be opened based on the number of Dragons each faction has secured final ownership of. A faction that secures final ownership of <Assistant_Red>two Dragons</> can unlock more generous auction rewards. Players who participate during the event will receive auction eligibility and dividend rewards. Each player can obtain a maximum of <Assistant_Red>1</> Dragon auction qualification per event. If the Dragon is not repelled before the event ends, it will depart without triggering kill settlement. 
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Rewards: </>When the Dragon in the player's current channel is defeated, participation rewards are settled. Rewards are based on the percentage of the Dragon's total HP dealt by the player's faction, settled according to the <Assistant_Red>highest tier</> reached, and distributed via mail after the crusade ends. 

Each player can settle <Assistant_Red>1 participation reward</> per Dragon crusade event. Once settlement is completed, switching channels to continue participating in the crusade will not trigger another settlement.

<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="web=%s">1.2版本调研问卷</>
      感谢您对这段旅程的见证，愿灵性为您指引前路。

ref_en: Roselle summons eight numbers that descend from the sky. Beyonders must touch them to acquire information. The numbers landing on the ground will deal damage to the entire party.

source_cn: 场地内出现需要共同解决的数字谜题，一段时间后根据<Disable>范围内数字总和</>计算结果，答案错误会造成全屏伤害。

source_cn: 罗塞尔对当前<Disable>仇恨目标</>造成击飞和高额伤害，附加持续一段时间的<Disable>大脑宕机</>效果，受到罗塞尔普通攻击伤害大幅提高，持续期间受治疗降低。
ref_en: Roselle deals knockup and high damage to the current <Disable> aggro target </>, applying a <Disable> Brain Crash </> effect that lasts for a period of time. Damage taken from Roselle's normal attacks is significantly increased, and healing received is reduced for the duration.

source_cn: 罗塞尔蓄力一段时间后爆发巨量的知识，<Disable>面向罗塞尔</>的非凡者会被致盲和眩晕。

ref_en: Roselle marks several Beyonders. After a period of time, they deal area damage and generate a <Disable> Gear Launcher </>, which continuously generates gears.

source_cn: 罗塞尔生成高额减伤的护盾和一个分身，分身<Disable>依次点名数字1-8的非凡者冲锋</>，分身冲过护盾会削减护盾层数。
ref_en: Roselle generates a shield with high damage reduction and a clone. The clone <Disable> marks Beyonders with numbers 1-8 in sequence to charge </>. If the clone charges through the shield, it will reduce the shield's layers.

source_cn: 罗塞尔点名数个非凡者一段时间后释放扇形伤害，被扇形伤害命中的齿轮会被消除，剩余没有消除的齿轮会被<Disable>回收并造成全屏伤害</>。
ref_en: Roselle marks several Beyonders, and after a period of time, releases fan-shaped damage. Gears hit by the fan-shaped damage will be eliminated, and any remaining gears will be <Disable> reclaimed, dealing full-screen damage </>.

source_cn: 罗塞尔在脚下生成高伤法阵，召唤八个密码装置和一个密码台，密码台交互后会出现<Disable>和正确位置对应的密码</>，全部密码填入后解除机制。
ref_en: Roselle generates a high-damage magic circle at his feet and summons eight password devices and a password console. Interacting with the password console will reveal <Disable> the password corresponding to the correct position </>. The mechanism is cleared once all passwords are entered.

source_cn:
巨龙被击败时，讨伐范围内当前累计有效归属伤害最高的团队获得<Highlight>拍卖奖励</>。玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在团队对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的<Highlight>最高档位</>结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Highlight>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。
ref_en:
When the Giant Dragon is defeated, the team with the highest cumulative effective ownership damage within the crusade range receives the <Highlight> auction reward </>. When the Giant Dragon in the player's current sub-channel is defeated, participation rewards are settled. Rewards are settled based on the percentage of the Giant Dragon's total HP dealt by the player's team, according to the <Highlight> highest tier </> achieved, and distributed via mail after the crusade ends. 
 
 Each player can settle participation rewards at most <Highlight> 1 time </> per Giant Dragon crusade event. After settlement is complete, switching sub-channels to continue participating in the crusade will not result in another settlement.

source_cn:
巨龙被击败时，累计有效归属伤害最高的势力获得最终归属。
势力拍卖：两条分线的巨龙全部被击败后，根据各势力取得最终归属的巨龙数量，开启对应档位的势力拍卖。同一势力取得<Highlight>两条巨龙</>的最终归属，可开启更丰厚的拍卖奖励。玩家在活动期间参与，即可获得拍卖资格和分红奖励。
参与奖励：玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在势力对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的最高档位结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Highlight>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。
ref_en:
When the Giant Dragon is defeated, the faction with the highest cumulative effective ownership damage gains final ownership. 
 Faction Auction: After the Giant Dragons in both sub-channels are defeated, the faction auction for the corresponding tier is opened based on the number of Giant Dragons each faction has gained final ownership of. If the same faction gains final ownership of <Highlight> both Giant Dragons </>, more generous auction rewards can be opened. Players who participate during the event will receive auction eligibility and dividend rewards. 
 Participation Rewards: When the Giant Dragon in the player's current sub-channel is defeated, participation rewards are settled. Rewards are settled based on the percentage of the Giant Dragon's total HP dealt by the player's faction, according to the highest tier achieved, and distributed via mail after the crusade ends. 
 
 Each player can settle participation rewards at most <Highlight> 1 time </> per Giant Dragon crusade event. After settlement is complete, switching sub-channels to continue participating in the crusade will not result in another settlement.

source_cn: 提升评估</> 1.展示此物品的<Highlight>属性词条</>带来的能力提升，不考虑特殊效果（如装备的烙印、套装、恩赐效果，封印物愚者词条）的影响； 2.仅计算常见的<Highlight>攻防属性</>，部分特殊属性（如攻击速度增幅、获得护盾增幅）不纳入计算范围； 3.提升幅度会随选取的<Highlight>目标场景</>、非凡者<Highlight>当前属性</>和<Highlight>对抗目标的属性</>变动，并非完全准确，仅供参考； 4.当非凡者<Highlight>当前属性</>与<Highlight>对抗目标的属性</>差距过大时，部分效果值已达上限或下限，提升幅度会迅速衰减甚至归零，此时的评估会严重失真。
ref_en: Improvement Assessment</> 1. Displays the ability improvement brought by the <Highlight>attribute entries</> of this item, without considering the influence of special effects (such as equipment imprints, set effects, blessing effects, or Sealed Artifact Fool entries); 2. Only calculates common <Highlight>attack and defense attributes</>; some special attributes (such as attack speed boost or shield gain boost) are not included in the calculation; 3. The improvement magnitude will vary with the selected <Highlight>target scenario</>, the Beyonder's <Highlight>current attributes</>, and the <Highlight>opponent's attributes</>. It is not entirely accurate and is for reference only; 4. When the gap between the Beyonder's <Highlight>current attributes</> and the <Highlight>opponent's attributes</> is too large, some effect values will have reached their upper or lower limits, causing the improvement magnitude to decay rapidly or even drop to zero. The assessment will be severely distorted in such cases.

加入或创建俱乐部，可以参与各种俱乐部活动玩法，获取丰厚的活动奖励和同行纹章，同行纹章可在俱乐部商店中兑换奖励道具。
俱乐部分为休闲俱乐部和战斗俱乐部，可在俱乐部信息修改处进行调整，休闲俱乐部不会在成员列表显示非凡评分。
俱乐部徽章随获取途径的发奖同步结算：竞赛徽章在玩法结算后发放，玩法徽章在下周一0点发放。
ref_en:
Join or create a Club to participate in various Club activities and gameplay, earning rich activity rewards and Companion Emblems. Companion Emblems can be exchanged for reward items in the Club Shop. 
Clubs are divided into Leisure Clubs and Combat Clubs, which can be adjusted in the Club information settings. Leisure Clubs will not display Beyonder ratings in the member list. 
Club badges are settled synchronously with the distribution of rewards from their respective acquisition channels: Competition badges are issued after the gameplay settlement, and gameplay badges are issued at 0:00 next Monday.

source_cn: 诡秘世界</> 诡秘世界页签中，可查看各地图<Highlight>秩序世界</>和<Highlight>城市暗面</>的玩法进度，并领取<Highlight>进度奖励</>。 <Highlight>风尚沙龙、时代任务</>不会计入秩序世界的完成度。 页签中的玩法奖励为通用预览奖励，实际奖励会根据点位有所差别，以地图点位奖励为准。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>跑团天赋</> 跑团天赋页签中，可根据秩序世界的完成度获得跑团相关的<Highlight>天赋加成</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>趣味玩法</> 趣味玩法收纳了冒险过程中遇到的各种玩法事件教程。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>珍藏瞬间</> 珍藏瞬间中收纳了冒险过程中收集到的宝贵瞬间记录。
ref_en: Mysterious World</> In the Mysterious World tab, you can view the gameplay progress of each map's <Highlight>Order World</> and <Highlight>City's Dark Side</>, and claim <Highlight>progress rewards</>. <Highlight>Fashion Salon and Era Quests</> are not counted towards the completion of the Order World. The gameplay rewards in the tab are general preview rewards; actual rewards vary by location and are subject to the map point rewards. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>TRPG Talent</> In the TRPG Talent tab, you can obtain TRPG-related <Highlight>talent bonuses</> based on the completion of the Order World. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Fun Gameplay</> Fun Gameplay contains tutorials for various gameplay events encountered during the adventure. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Treasured Moments</> Treasured Moments contains records of precious moments collected during the adventure.

source_cn: 比赛规则</> 赛场使用<Highlight>玩家真实属性</>，<Highlight>装备、封印物、秘偶、人脉、非凡天赋系统效果</>均可生效。玩家将以战队形式进行比赛，每个战队内同途径玩家最多为两名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>报名规则</> 比赛报名开启后，玩家即可组建或加入战队，战队成员<Highlight>达到5名</>后即可报名。 开启报名至锁定报名期间，战队队长可自由调整战队成员，成员也可自由离开战队，已报名战队若成员变动导致成员数量小于5名后将自动取消报名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>锁定规则</> 锁定报名期间，已报名战队可以进入准备场地，未报名战队仍可以进行报名操作，玩家也可以加入战队，但不可以主动离开或队长请离战队，已报名战队将不允许取消报名。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>获胜条件</> 限时时间内击败敌方队伍内所有玩家获胜，若对局时间结束时双方队伍均有成员存活，则顺次按照击败人数、存活人数、伤害总量、存活血量判定较高的一方获胜。每个队伍拥有<Highlight>2次复活</>死亡队友的机会。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>对战规则</> 比赛正式开始后，玩家需要<Highlight>停留在准备场地</>以保证正常进入比赛，擅自离开准备场地将导致无法正常参加比赛。 小组赛阶段，每轮随机匹配对手进行单局比赛，共进行六轮，根据胜场数选出16支队伍晋级，胜场数相同会根据<Highlight>荣耀值决出晋级者（荣耀值参考击杀数、战斗时长）</>。 小组赛结束后进入助力阶段，淘汰赛开始前根据<Highlight>助力值和荣耀值总和</>确定淘汰赛位次，淘汰赛开始后仍可进行助力，但不再影响淘汰赛位次。 淘汰赛阶段将进行<Highlight>三局两胜</>来确定胜负，决赛将进行<Highlight>五局三胜</>决出冠军！
ref_en: Competition Rules</> The arena uses <Highlight>players' real attributes</>, and effects from <Highlight>Equipment, Sealed Artifacts, Marionettes, Connections, and Beyonder Talent systems</> all take effect. Players compete in teams, with a maximum of two players of the same Pathway per team. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Registration Rules</> Once competition registration opens, players can form or join a team. A team can register once it <Highlight>reaches 5 members</>. From the start of registration until it is locked, the team leader can freely adjust team members, and members can freely leave the team. If a registered team's member count falls below 5 due to changes, the registration will be automatically canceled. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Locking Rules</> During the registration lock period, registered teams can enter the preparation area. Unregistered teams can still register, and players can join teams, but they cannot voluntarily leave or be removed by the leader. Registered teams are not allowed to cancel their registration. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Victory Conditions</> Defeat all players of the enemy team within the time limit to win. If both teams have members alive when the match time ends, the winner is determined sequentially by the number of kills, number of survivors, total damage, and total remaining HP. Each team has <Highlight>2 opportunities to resurrect</> dead teammates. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Match Rules</> After the competition officially begins, players must <Highlight>stay in the preparation area</> to ensure they enter the match normally. Leaving the preparation area without authorization will result in being unable to participate in the match. In the group stage, each round randomly matches opponents for a single match. A total of six rounds are played, and 16 teams are selected to advance based on the number of wins. If the number of wins is the same, the advancers are determined by <Highlight>Glory Value (based on kills and combat duration)</>. After the group stage, the support phase begins. Before the knockout stage starts, the knockout bracket is determined based on the <Highlight>sum of Support Value and Glory Value</>. Support can still be given after the knockout stage starts, but it will no longer affect the knockout bracket. The knockout stage will use a <Highlight>best-of-three</> format to determine the winner, and the final will use a <Highlight>best-of-five</> format to determine the champion!

1.事件目标：在特定区域参与并完成出现的突发事件，即可获得丰厚奖励。
2.事件类型：事件包含<Highlight>“剧情”、“挑战”、“竞技”</>三种类型。
3.刷新规则：当玩家进入“罪恶廷根”后会直接刷新出所有满足条件的事件，其中<Highlight>“竞技”事件报名时间为两分钟</>，突发事件刷新时间间隔，会取玩家进入场景的时间，<Highlight>“挑战”事件每间隔约10秒钟后会进行刷新</>，如果事件已结束则会再次出现。
4.奖励规则：不同事件类型的奖励规则不同，<Highlight>“剧情”事件成功可领奖，“挑战”事件有不同的分档奖励，“困难·挑战”不设分档奖励，“竞技”事件会根据玩家排名发奖</>。在特定活动期间，道具获取速度可加快，界面显示的数量均为加成后的最终数量。
5.奖励上限：单个玩家每周通过事件获得奖励的次数无上限，但是<Highlight>每周悬赏值有上限</>。
6.失败条件：若在事件时限内未能完成目标（若有），则视为事件失败。
7.脱离判定：若在事件完成前离开事件区域过远，会被判定为放弃事件，无法获得奖励。
8.玩家战力：进入“罪恶廷根”位面会进行属性平衡，玩家在其中的“剧情”、困难·挑战”、“竞技”都为属性平衡玩法，<Highlight>“激战·邦尼”会受玩家战力影响，根据玩家战力转化梯度的属性平衡</>。
ref_en:
1. Event Objective: Participate in and complete the sudden events that appear in specific areas to receive generous rewards.
2. Event Types: Events include three types: <Highlight>"Story", "Challenge", and "Competition".</>
3. Refresh Rules: When players enter "Sinful Tingen", all events meeting the conditions will be refreshed immediately. Among them, the registration time for <Highlight>"Competition" events is two minutes</>. The refresh interval for sudden events is based on the time the player enters the scene; <Highlight>"Challenge" events refresh every 10 seconds or so</>, and if an event has ended, it will reappear.
4. Reward Rules: Reward rules vary by event type. <Highlight>"Story" events grant rewards upon success, "Challenge" events have tiered rewards, "Hard · Challenge" events do not have tiered rewards, and "Competition" events distribute rewards based on player ranking</>. During specific event periods, the acquisition rate of items may be accelerated, and the quantities displayed in the interface are the final amounts after bonuses.
5. Reward Limit: There is no upper limit to the number of times a single player can receive rewards from events per week, but <Highlight>there is a weekly cap on Bounty Points</>.
6. Failure Conditions: If the objective (if any) is not completed within the event time limit, the event is considered a failure.
7. Leaving the Area: If you move too far away from the event area before the event is completed, it will be judged as abandoning the event, and you will not be able to receive rewards.
8. Player Combat Power: Entering the "Sinful Tingen" plane will trigger attribute balancing. "Story", "Hard · Challenge", and "Competition" modes within it are all attribute-balanced gameplay. <Highlight>"Fierce Battle · Bonnie" is affected by player combat power, with attribute balancing based on a gradient conversion of the player's combat power.</>

source_cn: 【非凡历史】为常驻结交人脉活动。 概率信息</> <Highlight>[传说]</>品质人脉：基础概率为1.5%，综合概率（含保底）为3.74% 包含：奥黛丽·霍尔、伦纳德·米切尔、佛尔思·沃尔、邓恩·史密斯、戴莉·西蒙妮、阿尔杰·威尔逊 <Highlight>[史诗]</>品质人脉：基础概率为10%，综合概率（含保底）为22.56% 包含：苏茜、洛薇雅·蒂芙尼、老尼尔、弗莱、弗兰克·李、班森·莫雷蒂、梅丽莎·莫雷蒂 <Highlight>[常规道具]相关</>：基础概率为88.5%，综合概率（含保底）为73.70% 包含：基础物质、聚合因子 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>结交细则</> 1、每5次结交，必定获得一位史诗或以上的人脉。 2、如果连续24次结交未获得传说人脉，则后续概率逐渐提升。 每40次结交必定获得传说人脉。 获得传说人脉后计数重置，概率恢复为基础概率。 3、【非凡历史】的保底次数与其它活动独立计算，互不影响。 4、可通过许愿提升结交获得对应人脉的概率。 许愿后，获得传说人脉时，对应目标概率提高到80%。 如果获得的传说人脉不是目标，则下次获得传说人脉必为许愿目标。 许愿每周可生效2次，周一重置。 每当结交人脉110次，可额外获得一次许愿次数。该次数不会被重置，且消耗优先级低于每周重置的次数。 5、本活动开服第二日起每日可获得100次结交次数，首次开放额外增加200次。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>重复获得人脉</> 重复获得相同传说人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和10个投影片段。如果该传说人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为40个投影片段。 重复获得相同史诗人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和2个投影片段。如果该史诗人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为2个投影片段。 投影片段可用于在人脉商店兑换道具。
ref_en: [Extraordinary History] is a permanent networking event. Probability Information </> <Highlight> [Legendary] </> Quality Connections: Base probability is 1.5%, cumulative probability (including pity) is 3.74%. Includes: Audrey Hall, Leonard Mitchell, Fors Wall, Dunn Smith, Daly Simone, Alger Wilson. <Highlight> [Epic] </> Quality Connections: Base probability is 10%, cumulative probability (including pity) is 22.56%. Includes: Susie, Lovia Tiffany, Old Neil, Frye, Frank Lee, Benson Moretti, Melissa Moretti. <Highlight> [Common Items] Related </>: Base probability is 88.5%, cumulative probability (including pity) is 73.70%. Includes: Basic Materials, Polymerization Factors. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Networking Rules </> 1. Every 5 connections, you are guaranteed to obtain an Epic or higher quality connection. 2. If you do not obtain a Legendary connection after 24 consecutive attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary connection every 40 attempts. After obtaining a Legendary connection, the count resets, and the probability returns to the base rate. 3. The pity count for [Extraordinary History] is calculated independently of other events and does not affect them. 4. You can use Wishes to increase the probability of obtaining a corresponding connection. After wishing, when you obtain a Legendary connection, the probability of the target increases to 80%. If the Legendary connection obtained is not the target, the next Legendary connection obtained is guaranteed to be the wish target. Wishes can be activated twice per week and reset on Monday. Every 110 connections, you can obtain an additional Wish attempt. This count will not be reset, and its consumption priority is lower than the weekly reset attempts. 5. Starting from the second day of the server opening, you can obtain 100 connection attempts daily, with an additional 200 attempts added upon the first opening. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Duplicate Connections </> When you obtain a duplicate Legendary connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding connection upgrade material and 10 projection fragments. If the Legendary connection has already reached the limit or the materials are sufficient to reach the limit, the excess upgrade materials will be converted into 40 projection fragments. When you obtain a duplicate Epic connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding connection upgrade material and 2 projection fragments. If the Epic connection has already reached the limit or the materials are sufficient to reach the limit, the excess upgrade materials will be converted into 2 projection fragments. Projection fragments can be used to exchange for items in the Connection Shop.

歌剧魅影是俱乐部之间比拼时装搭配的大型比赛活动，每周准时举行。
歌剧魅影共分为四个阶段。
搭配阶段：每周指定时间后，公布本周的时装搭配主题，需要根据对应主题，搭配高分的时装搭配组合
调整阶段：搭配阶段结束后，俱乐部搭配总评前五名会被选入比赛，会长/外交官可以调整出战顺序，利用策略击败对手
比赛阶段：调整阶段结束后，比赛将会在歌剧魅影舞台开始，场地内会开启一场盛大的表演，决出俱乐部的胜负
休整阶段：比赛结束后，直到下次搭配阶段开始前，歌剧魅影会处于休整阶段

每一轮歌剧魅影分为三小场，决出小组内的最强俱乐部，三场均完成后会进行升降级。
歌剧魅影使用的赛区会和四方联赛保持一致，但进行独立的升降级

调整开启：周三 19：30
比赛开启：周三 20：00
第三场：
搭配开启：周四 10：00
调整开启：周五 19：30
比赛开启：周五 20：00

Phantom of the Opera is a large-scale competition event where clubs compete in fashion styling, held punctually every week. 
 Phantom of the Opera is divided into four stages. 
 Styling Stage: After the designated time each week, the fashion styling theme for the week is announced. You need to create a high-scoring fashion combination based on the theme. 
 Adjustment Stage: After the styling stage ends, the top five clubs in terms of total styling rating will be selected for the competition. The President/Diplomat can adjust the battle order to use strategies to defeat opponents. 
 Competition Stage: After the adjustment stage ends, the competition will begin on the Phantom of the Opera stage. A grand performance will take place in the venue to determine the winner between the clubs. 
 Rest Stage: After the competition ends, until the next styling stage begins, Phantom of the Opera will be in the rest stage. 
 
 Each round of Phantom of the Opera is divided into three sub-matches to determine the strongest club in the group. After all three matches are completed, promotion or relegation will occur. 
 The competition zones used for Phantom of the Opera will be consistent with the Four-Way League, but will have independent promotion and relegation. 
 
 Specific competition times (excluding the first match after server opening): 
 First Match: 
 Styling Opens: Thursday 10:00 
 Adjustment Opens: Friday 19:30 
 Competition Opens: Friday 20:00 
 Second Match: 
 Styling Opens: Monday 10:00 
 Adjustment Opens: Wednesday 19:30 
 Competition Opens: Wednesday 20:00 
 Third Match: 
 Styling Opens: Thursday 10:00 
 Adjustment Opens: Friday 19:30 
 Competition Opens: Friday 20:00

<Highlight>【规则说明】</>

<Title>灵性之力</>
1.邦尼洒下了灵性碎片，疯狂地抢夺吧。
2.场地中央降下一道雷电特性，触碰即可暂时掌控雷电之力。
3.使用雷电之力击败敌人即可获得大量灵性，但期间无法拾取其他任何灵性之力。
<Title>收集灵性</>
1.场地上还会四处飘浮着其他灵性光球，触碰可获得不同的能力。
2.巧妙运用获得的技能与敌人周旋，同时尽可能收集更多的灵性碎片。
3.有时候，拳头可能比灵性更好用。
<Title>随机规则</>
1.游戏共进行三轮，每轮仪式都会出现不同的规则。
2.根据环境的变化调整你的策略，成为最终赢家！
3.不努力的人可是得不到邦尼奖励的奥。
ref_en:
<Highlight>【Rule Explanation】</>

<Title>Spirituality Power</>
1. Bonnie has scattered spirituality fragments; scramble to grab them!
2. A lightning characteristic will descend in the center of the arena; touch it to temporarily control the power of lightning.
3. Use the power of lightning to defeat enemies to gain a large amount of spirituality, but you will be unable to pick up any other spirituality power during this time.
<Title>Collecting Spirituality</>
1. Other spirituality light orbs will float around the arena; touch them to gain different abilities.
2. Cleverly use the skills you've acquired to maneuver around enemies while collecting as many spirituality fragments as possible.
3. Sometimes, your fists might be more useful than spirituality.
<Title>Random Rules</>
1. The game consists of three rounds, and different rules will appear for each ritual.
2. Adjust your strategy according to the changing environment to become the final winner!
3. Those who don't put in the effort won't get Bonnie's rewards.

<Title>神选席位</>
战略服势力对战阶段，神选席位由<Highlight>每周排名结算席位</>与<Highlight>最终排名结算席位</>共同组成。每周将根据战略服各势力的周排名，以及俱乐部在所属势力内的排名发放席位，排名越高，可获得的席位越多；战略服结算时，将根据各势力的最终排名，为势力内俱乐部发放最终排名结算席位。俱乐部获得的神选席位由俱乐部管理在俱乐部内部分配。

<Title>奖励内容</>
神选奖励包括<Highlight>战略服专属外观奖励、养成道具、苏勒、绑定金镑</>等。

<Title>限时神降</>
战略服结算时，最终排名第一的势力中，四个俱乐部的<Highlight>会长、外交官、理事</>可获得限时30天的神降时装<Highlight>铁与血之歌</>。

ref_en:
<Title>God-Chosen Seat</>
During the Strategic Server faction battle phase, the God-Chosen Seat is composed of <Highlight>Weekly Ranking Settlement Seats</> and <Highlight>Final Ranking Settlement Seats</>. Each week, seats will be distributed based on the weekly ranking of each faction on the Strategic Server, as well as the club's ranking within its faction; the higher the ranking, the more seats can be obtained. Upon the Strategic Server settlement, Final Ranking Settlement Seats will be distributed to clubs within the faction based on the faction's final ranking. The God-Chosen Seats obtained by a club are distributed internally by the club management.

<Title>Reward Content</>
God-Chosen rewards include <Highlight>Strategic Server exclusive cosmetic rewards, cultivation items, soli, Bound Gold Pounds</>, etc.

<Title>Limited-Time Divine Descent</>
At the Strategic Server settlement, the <Highlight>President, Diplomat, and Director</> of the four clubs in the faction ranked first overall can obtain the 30-day limited-time Divine Descent outfit <Highlight>Song of Iron and Blood</>.

<Title>Reward Distribution</>
Rewards will be distributed uniformly <Highlight>after the Strategic Server Victor's Declaration Ceremony ends</>.

source_cn:
<Title>巨龙现身</>
巨龙·投影于每周五、周日晚的猎杀时刻开启<Highlight>10分钟后</>，即<Highlight>19:10</>，现身<Highlight>猎龙城王城中心</>。若20:00前未被击退，巨龙将离开，且不触发击杀结算。

<Title>归属伤害</>
仅在巨龙周围<Highlight>40米</>内存活并对其造成伤害时，伤害才会计入玩家当前所在团队。巨龙被击退时，<Highlight>当前有效归属伤害最高的团队</>获得最终归属及拍卖奖励。靠近巨龙后，可实时查看当前归属伤害。

<Title>伤害衰减</>
玩家死亡、离开巨龙讨伐范围、切换分线或离开团队后，该玩家已为团队累计的归属伤害将开始衰减，并同步影响团队当前的有效归属伤害。

触发衰减后的<Highlight>前5秒</>，归属伤害保持不变；从第6秒开始，<Highlight>每6秒减少原累计归属伤害的5%</>，持续120秒后归零。

重新进入<Highlight>巨龙讨伐范围</>并恢复参战后，衰减停止。当前剩余的归属伤害将被保留，并在此基础上继续累计新造成的伤害。

<Title>拍卖奖励</>
击退巨龙后，将根据激战值开启对应档位的拍卖。<Highlight>激战值越高，可开启的拍卖奖励档位越高</>。

<Title>资格限制</>
每次猎杀时刻活动中，每名玩家至多获得<Highlight>1次</>巨龙·投影的终末猎杀拍卖资格；已取得资格的玩家，本次活动内无法再次取得。

<Title>参与奖励</>
玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在团队对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的<Highlight>最高档位</>结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Highlight>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。
ref_en:
<Title>Dragon Appearance</>
The Dragon - Projection begins during the Hunting Time on Friday and Sunday evenings. <Highlight>After 10 minutes</>, at <Highlight>19:10</>, it will appear in the <Highlight>center of the Dragon Hunting City Royal Capital</>. If it is not repelled before 20:00, the Dragon will depart, and no kill rewards will be triggered.

<Title>Attribution Damage</>
Damage only counts toward the player's current team if the player is alive and dealing damage within <Highlight>40 meters</> of the Dragon. When the Dragon is repelled, the <Highlight>team with the highest current effective attribution damage</> receives the final attribution and auction rewards. You can view the current attribution damage in real-time after approaching the Dragon.

<Title>Damage Decay</>
If a player dies, leaves the Dragon crusade range, switches channels, or leaves their team, the attribution damage they have accumulated for their team will begin to decay, which will also affect the team's current effective attribution damage.

For the <Highlight>first 5 seconds</> after decay is triggered, the attribution damage remains unchanged. Starting from the 6th second, <Highlight>it decreases by 5% of the original accumulated attribution damage every 6 seconds</>, reaching zero after 120 seconds of continuous decay.

Upon re-entering the <Highlight>Dragon crusade range</> and resuming combat, the decay stops. The remaining attribution damage will be retained, and new damage dealt will be accumulated on top of it.

<Title>Auction Rewards</>
After the Dragon is repelled, an auction will be opened based on the intensity of the battle. <Highlight>The higher the battle intensity, the higher the tier of auction rewards that can be unlocked</>.

<Title>Eligibility Restrictions</>
During each Hunting Time event, each player can obtain the Dragon - Projection final hunt auction eligibility at most <Highlight>1 time</>; players who have already obtained eligibility cannot obtain it again during the current event.

<Title>Participation Rewards</>
When the Dragon in the player's current channel is defeated, participation rewards are calculated. Rewards are settled based on the percentage of the Dragon's total HP dealt by the player's team, according to the <Highlight>highest tier achieved</>, and will be sent via mail after the crusade ends.

Each player can receive participation rewards at most <Highlight>1 time</> per Dragon crusade event. Once settled, even if you switch channels to continue participating in the crusade, you will not be rewarded again.

ref_en:
1. Participating in various gameplay modes on the Strategic Server allows you to obtain God-Chosen Points. The weekly and final God-Chosen Seat quotas are determined based on the faction's point ranking, and the faction with the highest final God-Chosen Points wins this Strategic Server event.
2. Participating in the Hunting City Battle, Frost-Fall Lord, and Conquest Decree gameplay modes allows you to obtain War Merits. During the Strategic Server's Final Hunt, War Merits can only be obtained by killing or assisting in the killing of Beyonders from enemy factions during high-multiplier event periods.
3. Club Honor Points will serve as the standard for club sorting in subsequent server-wide trade wars. Honor Points will be calculated based on the club's God-Chosen Points and the Strategic Server's combat intensity.

<Title>God-Chosen Seats</>
Each week, God-Chosen Seat quotas will be allocated based on the current week's faction ranking and the club's God-Chosen Point contribution ranking within the faction. For the faction ranked first, the four clubs with the highest God-Chosen Point contributions receive 10/6/6/6 God-Chosen Seats respectively; for the faction ranked second, the four clubs receive 6/4/4/4 seats; for the faction ranked third, the four clubs receive 4/2/2/2 seats; for the faction ranked fourth, the four clubs receive 2/1/1/1 seats.
After the four-week Strategic Server gameplay ends, God-Chosen Seat quotas will be allocated based on the final faction ranking. The club belonging to the faction ranked first receives 30 God-Chosen Seat quotas; the club belonging to the faction ranked second receives 20 God-Chosen Seat quotas; the club belonging to the faction ranked third receives 10 God-Chosen Seat quotas.

1. Complete multi-player dungeons as a party leader or raid leader to earn Leader Points. The scale and difficulty of the dungeon, as well as the number of first-time participants and members with valid reward attempts in the team, will all affect the points earned. 
 2. Receive likes from team members upon dungeon settlement to earn additional Leader Points.

<Title>巨龙现身</>
战略服终末猎杀的巨龙讨伐于<Highlight>每周四、周六19:00—20:00</>开放。巨龙·投影在活动开启<Highlight>10分钟后</>，即<Highlight>19:10</>，现身<Highlight>猎龙城王城中心</>。若20:00前未被击退，巨龙将离开，且不触发击杀结算。

<Title>分线人数</>
每个战区常驻开放<Highlight>2条分线</>，每条分线中，单个势力最多<Highlight>160名玩家</>，单条分线总人数最多<Highlight>640人</>。

<Title>势力归属伤害</>
仅在巨龙周围<Highlight>40米</>内存活并对其造成伤害时，伤害才会计入玩家当前所属势力。同势力不同团队的伤害合并累计。巨龙被击退时，<Highlight>当前累计有效归属伤害最高的势力</>获得最终归属。靠近巨龙后，可实时查看当前势力的归属伤害。

<Title>伤害衰减</>
玩家死亡、离开巨龙讨伐范围或切换分线后，该玩家已为势力累计的归属伤害将开始衰减，并同步影响势力当前的有效归属伤害。

触发衰减后的<Highlight>前5秒</>，归属伤害保持不变；从第6秒开始，<Highlight>每6秒减少原累计归属伤害的5%</>，持续120秒后归零。

重新进入<Highlight>巨龙讨伐范围</>并恢复参战后，衰减停止。当前剩余的归属伤害将被保留，并在此基础上继续累计新造成的伤害。

<Title>势力拍卖</>
<Highlight>两条分线的巨龙全部被击败后</>，根据各势力取得最终归属的巨龙数量，开启对应档位的势力拍卖。同一势力取得<Highlight>两条巨龙</>的最终归属，可开启更丰厚的拍卖奖励。玩家在活动期间参与，即可获得拍卖资格和分红奖励。

<Title>资格限制</>
每次终末猎杀活动中，每名玩家至多获得<Highlight>1次</>巨龙·投影的拍卖资格；已取得资格的玩家，本次活动内无法再次取得。

<Title>参与奖励</>
玩家当前所在分线的巨龙被击败时，结算参与奖励。奖励根据玩家所在势力对该巨龙造成的伤害占其总血量的百分比，按已达成的<Highlight>最高档位</>结算，并在讨伐结束后通过邮件发放。

每名玩家每次讨伐巨龙活动最多结算<Highlight>1次参与奖励</>。完成结算后，即使切换分线继续参与讨伐，也不会再次结算。

<Title>神选积分</>
巨龙被击退并确定最终归属后，获胜势力中<Highlight>符合资格的俱乐部</>可获得<Highlight>300点神选积分</>。每个俱乐部每次讨伐巨龙活动最多可获得<Highlight>2次</>神选积分奖励。

<Title> Dragon Appearance </> 
 The Dragon Hunt for the Strategic Server's Final Hunt is open <Highlight> every Thursday and Saturday from 19:00 to 20:00 </>. The Dragon - Projection appears <Highlight> 10 minutes after </> the event starts, at <Highlight> 19:10 </>, at the <Highlight> center of the Dragon Hunting City Royal Capital </>. If it is not repelled by 20:00, the Dragon will leave, and no kill settlement will be triggered. 
 
 <Title> Sub-channel Population </> 
 Each war zone has <Highlight> 2 sub-channels </> open permanently. In each sub-channel, a single faction can have at most <Highlight> 160 players </>, and the total population per sub-channel is at most <Highlight> 640 people </>. 
 
 <Title> Faction Attribution Damage </> 
 Only when you are alive within <Highlight> 40 meters </> of the Dragon and deal damage to it will the damage count toward your current faction. Damage from different teams within the same faction is accumulated together. When the Dragon is repelled, the <Highlight> faction with the highest cumulative effective attribution damage </> gains final attribution. After approaching the Dragon, you can view your faction's current attribution damage in real-time. 
 
 <Title> Damage Decay </> 
 After a player dies, leaves the Dragon Hunt range, or switches sub-channels, the attribution damage that player has accumulated for their faction will begin to decay, which will synchronously affect the faction's current effective attribution damage. 
 
 For the <Highlight> first 5 seconds </> after decay is triggered, attribution damage remains unchanged; starting from the 6th second, <Highlight> it decreases by 5% of the original cumulative attribution damage every 6 seconds </>, and reaches zero after 120 seconds. 
 
 After re-entering the <Highlight> Dragon Hunt range </> and resuming combat, the decay stops. The remaining attribution damage will be retained, and new damage dealt will continue to be accumulated on this basis. 
 
 <Title> Faction Auction </> 
 <Highlight> After the Dragons in both sub-channels are defeated </>, the faction auction for the corresponding tier will be opened based on the number of Dragons each faction has gained final attribution for. If the same faction gains final attribution for <Highlight> both Dragons </>, more generous auction rewards can be unlocked. Players who participate during the event will receive auction eligibility and dividend rewards. 
 
 <Title> Eligibility Restrictions </> 
 In each Final Hunt event, each player can obtain at most <Highlight> 1 </> auction eligibility for the Dragon - Projection; players who have already obtained eligibility cannot obtain it again during this event. 
 
 <Title> Participation Rewards </> 
 When the Dragon in the player's current sub-channel is defeated, participation rewards are settled. Rewards are settled based on the percentage of the Dragon's total Health dealt by the player's faction, according to the <Highlight> highest tier </> reached, and will be sent via mail after the hunt ends. 
 
 Each player can settle participation rewards at most <Highlight> 1 time </> per Dragon Hunt event. After settlement is complete, even if you switch sub-channels to continue participating in the hunt, you will not be settled again. 
 
 <Title> God-Chosen Points </> 
 After the Dragon is repelled and final attribution is determined, <Highlight> eligible clubs </> in the winning faction can obtain <Highlight> 300 God-Chosen Points </>. Each club can obtain God-Chosen Point rewards at most <Highlight> 2 times </> per Dragon Hunt event.

<Title>活动介绍</>
胜者自战场凯旋，于晨光中登上花车，让整座城市见证荣耀归来。
世界战略服的硝烟尚未散尽，胜者宣言的余音仍在耳畔回荡，而此刻，这份属于征服者的荣耀将从沙盘之上，带回到城市的街头。花车将穿过道路、广场与桥畔，沿途市民夹道欢呼，烟花在天空中绽放——一场献给征服者的最高礼遇。

<Title>活动资格</>
<Highlight>势力战胜者宣言大会</>结束后，获胜俱乐部将自动获得开启花车巡游的资格。资格有效期为<Highlight>一个月</>，期间每个俱乐部<Highlight>每周仅可开启一次</>；资格到期后统一回收，随下一届胜者宣言大会重新发放。活动开放时段为<Highlight>每周六、周日 18:00—24:00</>，会长可在此期间自行选择开启时间。

<Title>活动流程</>
会长在俱乐部活动界面开启花车巡游后，系统将在廷根新建一条巡游分线，并向全服发送公告。巡游队列将从<Highlight>梧桐大道</>出发，途经中央广场、金梧桐大街，最终到达廷根大桥。沿途路线设有多处<Highlight>定点表演</>，队列将短暂停留并开启烟花庆典；全服玩家均可传送至表演点位，点击<Highlight>【庆祝巡游】</>领取随机庆典奖励，同时与整座城市共同见证这一荣耀时刻。
ref_en:
<Title> Event Introduction </> 
 The victors return from the battlefield, boarding the float in the morning light, letting the whole city witness their glorious return. 
 The smoke of the world's Strategic Server has not yet dissipated, the echoes of the Victor's Declaration still linger in the ears, and now, this glory belonging to the conquerors will be brought back from the sandbox to the streets of the city. The float will pass through roads, plazas, and bridges, with citizens cheering along the way, and fireworks blooming in the sky—a supreme courtesy dedicated to the conquerors. 
 
 <Title> Event Eligibility </> 
 <Highlight> After the Faction War Victor's Declaration Assembly </> ends, the winning club will automatically gain the eligibility to start the float parade. The eligibility is valid for <Highlight> one month </>, during which each club <Highlight> can only start it once per week </>; the eligibility will be reclaimed uniformly after it expires and reissued with the next Victor's Declaration Assembly. The event is open <Highlight> every Saturday and Sunday from 18:00 to 24:00 </>, and the president can choose the start time during this period. 
 
 <Title> Event Process </> 
 After the president starts the float parade in the club event interface, the system will create a new parade sub-channel in Tingen and send an announcement to the entire server. The parade queue will depart from <Highlight> Wutong Avenue </>, pass through Central Plaza and Golden Wutong Street, and finally reach Tingen Bridge. There are multiple <Highlight> designated performance spots </> along the route, where the queue will stop briefly to start a firework celebration; all players on the server can teleport to the performance spots and click <Highlight> [Celebrate Parade] </> to receive random celebration rewards, while witnessing this glorious moment together with the whole city.

source_cn: 见证战略服至高荣耀的时刻即将到来，这场历时一月的征战也将迎来终章。各大俱乐部为势力荣光浴血奋战，于一次次交锋中赢得来之不易的神选席位。此刻，优胜势力中排名第一的俱乐部会长，将亲自执掌封赏之权，为同行至此的功勋者分授荣耀。这不仅是一份奖励，更是属于胜者的无上荣光，必将载入战略服史册。若逾期未完成分赏，神选席位将由系统自动发放。
ref_en: The moment to witness the supreme glory of the Strategic Server is coming, and this month-long battle will also reach its finale. Major clubs have fought bloody battles for the glory of their factions, winning hard-won God-Chosen Seats in clash after clash. Now, the president of the club ranked first in the winning faction will personally hold the power of reward, granting glory to the meritorious ones who have come this far. This is not just a reward, but a supreme glory belonging to the victors, which will surely be recorded in the annals of the Strategic Server. If the distribution is not completed within the time limit, the God-Chosen Seats will be issued automatically by the system.
